thread:
maya: Heads-up — during vuln triage we found a service-account with project-level Admin on payments-prod. Need quick owner/evidence for why that entitlement exists and when it was last reviewed. @oncall can you ack? :eyes:

jamal: Ack. Which SA? can you paste the IAM binding?

maya: svc-pay-xfer@redwood-prod. Binding: `roles/owner` on `projects/payments-prod` (seen in audit logs 2026-03-18T03:12Z). Link to raw audit event: https://logs.internal/reports/490123-evidence (internal)

oli: Yikes, owner on a SA is unexpected. I can take a look but need the justification/evidence. If no owner within 24h we should consider temporary demotion to roles/editor and open a ticket for remediation.

maya: Agreed. My initial grep shows last IAM policy change was 2025-11-02 and the principal that applied it is api-deploy-bot. That bot shouldn't be granting owner.

sasha: audits-bot pulled related bindings, attaching consolidated view: https://s3.internal/audit-views/payments-svc-pay-xfer-490123.csv

audits-bot: auto-note: evidence bundle generated for thread 4901234567. Contains IAM snapshot, KMS key grants, recent token usage (30d).

jamal: KMS question — does this SA have direct KMS CryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on any customer keys? If yes, we need key rotation plan + proof of recent decrypt ops.

maya: It has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on `projects/payments-prod/locations/global/keyRings/customer-keys/ck-main`. Decrypt ops show 12 calls in last 7 days by the SA (logs attached in bundle).

oli: Plan proposal: (1) immediate temporary downgrade to editor (no owner) via emergency ACL if owner not identified in 12h; (2) open infra ticket to rotate CK-main and re-encrypt any dependent artifacts; (3) run a least-privilege review for payments-prod service accounts next week.

maya: I like that. Also request that product/security stake-holders confirm any scheduled jobs relying on this SA (cron, rollouts). Please post links to failing runbooks if any.

oncall: oncall here — acknowledged and will coordinate the emergency ACL if no owner. Will also ensure the incident ticket is created: INC-2026-4901.

jamal: Command we used to snapshot binding (gcloud):
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy payments-prod --format=json > payments-iam-490123.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner")' payments-iam-490123.json
```

sasha: Quick ask for evidence hygiene: attach human-readable justification or PR link for the change if it exists. If not, mark as undocumented.

maya: I searched PRs — none found. Filing forensics card and flagging as undocumented change.

oli: Action items/timelines: 1) Owners to respond here within 12h (maya/jamal/oli will escalate). 2) If no owner, @oncall to apply temporary downgrade within 12-18h. 3) KMS rotation plan to be drafted within 48h and scheduled in the next maintenance window. 4) Full entitlement list for payments-prod to be delivered by end-of-week (SLA: 2026-03-26).

maya: Assignments: Jamal — lead KMS rotation plan. Oli — validate dependent jobs and runbooks. Sasha — consolidate audit bundle and upload final evidence to INC-2026-4901. Oncall — execute emergency ACL if needed.

oncall: Confirmed. I'll create INC ticket and ping infra/sre rotation owners.

jamal: I'll start the rotation doc and post link here in ~2h.

maya: Thanks team. Marking this thread as the official remediation coordination channel for this entitlement. :thumbsup:
